question: The strong nuclear force is found to be stronger when the spins of two nucleons are parallel compared to when they are anti-parallel. What does this observation imply about the nature of the nuclear force?

options.A: It is a purely central force like gravity.
options.B: It is a non-central force dependent on quantum states.
options.C: It is solely an electrostatic phenomenon.
